verdict.rationale: Phaser ships an official 'Phaser Game Agent' MCP server documented at phaser.io/agent/mcp, exposing 40+ specialized tools and integrating with Claude Desktop, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and other MCP-compatible agents, letting users describe games in plain language for the agent to build. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the MCP server actually working in practice, and detail on setup/auth requirements beyond first-party marketing copy.
